description: Brief-only politics essay (POL4010) with explicit requirements but no marking rubric. The brief requires 1,500 words (+/-10%), Harvard referencing, at least 6 academic sources, a thesis in the introduction, evaluated counter-arguments, a conclusion that answers the question, and .docx submission. The submitted .docx essay (1,486 words before the reference list, including title lines) is otherwise sound but has two deliberate defects: (1) the reference list contains only 4 academic sources; (2) counter-arguments are mentioned in a single sentence at the start of 'Weighing the evidence' without evaluation. The audit must run in BRIEF_ONLY mode, must not award a numerical mark, and must flag both defects against the explicit requirements without importing irrelevant criteria (code, methodology, research questions).
report_must_contain: NO AUTHORISED NUMERICAL MARKING SCHEME WAS PROVIDED.
